model: Orbital Economy v7.7.8 Deposits candidate r1
note: Task 023 fragment. All numeric model constants introduced by the deposit declaration are annotated, including A/B initial undiscovered resources, proven reserves and extraction-signal initial values. Regolith extraction-signal initials are 0/0 (symmetric), despite TASK_RU wording calling starting-signal pairs asymmetric.

Deposits Enabled.effect: 0 preserves legacy extraction-rate formulas in Modes 0-43; 1 enables reserve targeting, exploration demand/consumption, and the smooth depletion cap. Extraction FLOW endpoints remain retargeted to Proven Reserves in all modes.

Ore Deposit Target Reserve Life.role: Ore target proven-reserve life, value 5400 days.
Ore Deposit Target Reserve Life.effect: Multiplies the smoothed Ore extraction signal to set Target Proven Reserves.

Ore Deposit Exploration Time.role: Ore exploration adjustment time, value 1800 days.
Ore Deposit Exploration Time.effect: Divides the positive reserve gap to set Desired Exploration before the remaining-resource and capital-goods factors.

Ore Deposit Capital Goods per Discovery.role: Capital Goods requirement per unit of newly proven Ore, value 0.0002.
Ore Deposit Capital Goods per Discovery.effect: Converts Desired Exploration into Capital Goods demand and actual Exploration into Capital Goods consumption.

Ore Deposit Depletion Buffer Days.effect: Sets the reserve-based soft ceiling for the extraction rate when the deposit layer is enabled.

Ore Extraction Signal Adjustment Time.role: Ore extraction-signal adjustment time, value 30 days.
Ore Extraction Signal Adjustment Time.effect: Controls lag from the current extraction rate to the Ore Extraction Signal STOCK used for reserve targeting.

A Ore Undiscovered Resource Initial.role: Initial undiscovered Ore resource for colony A, value 20000000.
A Ore Undiscovered Resource Initial.effect: Seeds the finite planetary-scale undiscovered-resource STOCK; A/B pair is 20000000/3600000.

A Ore Proven Reserves Initial.role: Initial proven Ore reserves for colony A, value 200000.
A Ore Proven Reserves Initial.effect: Seeds the stock that supplies extraction; A/B pair is 200000/36000.

A Ore Extraction Signal.role: Initial smoothed Ore extraction signal for colony A, value 42.227.
A Ore Extraction Signal.effect: Seeds the reserve-target signal with the intentional A/B pair 42.227/8.373.
